scope: Two development observations from the same physical trial; not a held-out benchmark.
method: Fit wrist RGB silhouettes of visually learned solids, varying only translation axes unobserved by side RGB-D.
runtime_inputs: Wrist RGB, intrinsics, camera pose, learned visual geometry and side-camera translation constraints. No wrist depth or object truth.
truth_boundary: Simulator object centers were used only as offline error oracles.
timing_scope: Single-shot CPU fitting calls; excludes image acquisition, simulation, robot IK and the rest of policy.
